articles.title: The Kindle experience on the new Alexa tablets really does look ‘rad’
articles.summary: Credit: Amazon TL;DR Panos Panay has shown off Kindle Mode on Amazon’s new Alexa tablets in more detail. The mode transforms the device into a distraction-free reading experience. Opening a book automatically disables notifications, activates battery optimizations for up to 20 hours of reading, and enables an adaptive display and blue light filter. Amazon says the 12-inch Alexa Tablet 12 Pro’s 3:2 display offers more usable page space. Amazon’s new Alexa tablets have a neat trick up their sleeves, transforming into distraction-free reading devices when you open a book in the Kindle app. And if Panos Panay’s demo is anything to go by, the company sure does have something special in store for Kindle fans.

articles.title: 當威脅情報只剩大量數據，企業該相信什麼？
articles.summary:
生成式AI降低了偵察、釣魚郵件撰寫及部分程式開發工作的門檻，使攻擊者得以更快、更大量地展開行動，企業導入模型、資料集、套件與AI工具後，擴大了軟體及AI供應鏈的風險。
這兩股力量交織之下，企業面對的不再是單一威脅，而是速度與範圍同時擴張的攻擊環境。卡巴斯基臺灣技術總監謝長軒指出，AI能大量產出資料，決定防禦成敗的關鍵，不是誰握有最多預警訊號，而是誰能把海量資料轉化為可以立即行動的情報。
他認為，好的威脅情報必須同時具備來源可信、時間有效、脈絡相關、信心度清楚與可執行等條件，AI能加快前段處理，專家則負責高風險判斷與情境分析，兩者缺一不可。
